controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color from Gaia's spectrum of the star. The disc itself is unresolved; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere.
controls.notes: The color of the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,281 K and log g 2.85 (u1 0.374, u2 0.300): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
